sources.title: All You Need to Know About Training Image Retrieval Models
sources.snippet: Image retrieval is the task of finding images in a database that are most similar to a given query image. The performance of an image retrieval pipeline depends on many training-time factors, including the embedding model architecture, loss function, data sampler, mining function, learning rate(s), and batch size. sources.title: Llama Nemoretriever Colembed: Top-Performing Text-Image Retrieval Model
sources.snippet: Motivated by the growing demand for retrieval systems that operate across modalities, we introduce llama-nemoretriever-colembed, a unified text-image retrieval model that delivers state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks. We release two model variants, 1B and 3B.

sources.title: A Multimodal Biomedical Foundation Model Trained from Fifteen Million ...
sources.snippet: Biomedical data are inherently multimodal, comprising physical measurements and natural-language narratives. A generalist biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) model needs to simultaneously process different modalities of data, including text and images. Therefore, training an effective generalist biomedical model requires high-quality multimodal data, such as parallel image-text pairs.
